description: A PHP unit test class 'FormatWithUtcTimeTest' for testing the 'FormatWithDateTime' class's 'getFormattedValue' method in the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. The test verifies the correct formatting of DateTime objects into string representations with UTC time.

classes.name: FormatWithUtcTimeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'FormatWithDateTime' class's 'getFormattedValue' method.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with an instance of 'FormatWithDateTime' before each test.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the 'getFormattedValue' method with a DateTime object and an invalid string input, asserting the expected formatted string and null output.
